news.title: GB Realty to invest over ₹5,000 crore in North India expansion
news.para: GB Realty plans to invest over ₹5,000 crore over the next three years and about ₹10,000 crore over five years. The company has earmarked about ₹3,500 crore for luxury and ultra-luxury residential projects.

news.title: JSW Dulux’s net profit declines 12% to ₹79.70 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: In the June quarter, JSW Dulux experienced a 12.4 percent decline in profits, alongside a modest 1.1 percent drop in total income. In response to raw material inflation, the company raised prices, contributing to a 14.7 percent growth in EBITDA through effective cost management. Furthermore, a stock split is on the table, awaiting necessary approvals.

news.title: Kolte-Patil Developers posts ₹146.66 crore net profit in Q1 FY27
news.para: Kolte-Patil Developers reported a substantial profit increase for the June quarter.  The company's total income also saw a significant rise compared to last year.  Pre-sales and collections demonstrated strong year-on-year growth during this period.  New redevelopment projects were added, boosting future development potential.  Financial ratios indicate a stable and healthy balance sheet for the firm.

news.title: Arkade Developers’ net profit declines 34% to ₹19.07 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Arkade Developers reported a significant profit decline of 33.7 percent in the June quarter, alongside a ten percent year-on-year decrease in total income. Despite this downturn, pre-sales experienced a positive shift, increasing by nine percent in the same timeframe. The company's collections reached ₹164 crore, slightly down from the prior year, while they maintain a robust project pipeline worth ₹12,800 crore.

news.title: NBCC (India)’s net profit rises 17% to ₹158 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: NBCC India reported a seventeen percent growth in profit for the June 2026 quarter, achieving a net profit of ₹158 crore compared to ₹135.03 crore the previous year. However, total income experienced a minor decline of five point nine percent. As a gesture to shareholders, the board has announced an interim dividend of ₹0.15 per equity share, equating to fifteen percent of the face value.

news.title: Embassy Developments’ net loss widens 42% to ₹234.40 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Embassy Developments has reported a consolidated net loss of ₹234.40 crore for the first quarter of FY27. During this time, the total consolidated income plunged to ₹241.28 crore. However, on a positive note, pre-sales skyrocketed by 338% on a year-on-year basis, reaching ₹868 crore, while collections rose by 54%, totaling around ₹496 crore. The board has sanctioned raising ₹362.62 crore through a preferential issue to enhance its financial strength.

news.title: Green debt share in REIT borrowings may rise to 15-17% in three years: ICRA
news.para: Outstanding green borrowings of Indian REITs rose to about ₹8,400 crore as of March 2026 from about ₹1,200 crore in March 2022, according to ICRA. The share of green debt in total REIT borrowings doubled to 12% from 6% during the period.

news.title: India's first buyer-centric home buying platform: How Housiey is redefining trust in real estate
news.para: Housiey stands as India’s pioneering home-buying platform designed with buyers in mind, emphasizing well-informed choices. By providing essential information such as project litigation and necessary legal documentation, Housiey fosters trust and confidence among property buyers. To date, the platform has successfully enabled home sales exceeding ₹9,000 crore, targeting the goal of becoming India’s most reliable home-buying resource.

news.title: Table Space files DRHP for ₹800 crore IPO
news.para: Tablespace Technologies, which operates managed workspace brand Table Space, has filed its draft red herring prospectus with SEBI for an IPO. The proposed issue comprises a fresh issue of up to ₹800 crore and an offer for sale of up to 6.55 crore equity shares.

news.title: Telangana opens doors for homestays, to invite families into tourism economy
news.para: Telangana is launching a new homestay scheme for homeowners to host tourists. This initiative aims to boost tourism beyond major cities and hotels. Eligible properties include independent houses and traditional dwellings across the state. The government will act as a facilitator, promoting community-based tourism experiences. This policy is part of Telangana's broader tourism development plan.

news.title: Chandigarh housing board residents face regulatory challenges due to frequent policy changes
news.para: Residents of the Chandigarh Housing Board are grappling with regulatory hurdles stemming from frequent policy changes. With previous constructions retroactively classified as violations, they face considerable distress. Many express that the retrospective application of new regulations imposes unfair burdens and legal issues. The Board is aware of these challenges and is actively developing a new, need-based policy aimed at providing clarity and safeguarding homeowner rights.

news.title: New walls, gates and farmhouses come up again in protected Aravalis
news.para: Construction remains unabated at Ansal Aravali Retreat within the protected hills of Raisina, as a recent inspection revealed over two dozen active sites. This development is occurring despite ongoing proceedings with the National Green Tribunal and previous orders for restoration. The area is governed by strict laws banning unauthorized construction and tree removal.

news.title: Over 73,100 new houses approved under PMAY-Urban 2.0 in Uttar Pradesh
news.para: The Uttar Pradesh government has greenlit the construction of 73,184 new homes under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban 2.0 initiative, increasing the total number of sanctioned residences to 4,88,526 statewide. Chief Secretary S P Goyal called for stringent adherence to quality standards and timely project completion. He highlighted the necessity for quick delivery of housing to beneficiaries, with officials set to monitor progress rigorously to avert any delays.

news.title: Over 30 illegal buildings demolished in Gurugram for violating norms
news.para: Gurgaon's civic body demolished thirty-one structures during a citywide enforcement drive.  This action targeted unauthorized constructions and building bye-law violations across several areas.  The demolition drive is part of a month-long campaign following Supreme Court directions.  Officials stated illegal construction will not be tolerated and enforcement is ongoing.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh brings in OTS scheme for pending property tax dues
news.para: The Uttar Pradesh government has launched a new settlement scheme for property tax arrears. This initiative aims to recover pending house, water, and sewerage taxes across urban areas. Taxpayers can settle old dues through a simple process and avoid defaulter status. The scheme allows payment in a maximum of three installments over three months. Recovered revenue will fund improvements in public facilities and development works.

news.title: Ahmedabad: Building permission may be denied if area’s drainage is patchy
news.para: Ahmedabad might start denying development permissions for projects that do not include necessary drainage infrastructure. Recent heavy rainfall unveiled severe waterlogging in Bopal, Ghuma, and Shela, prompting authorities to reassess project approvals. This initiative aims to curb future flooding risks and enhance urban development. Major investments are already taking place to tackle these pressing infrastructure challenges.

news.title: Goa: 9.7 lakh sq metres of land parcels notified as non-developable
news.para: The TCP department has revised the Regional Plan 2021, marking 9.7 lakh sqm as non-developable land. This area encompasses Majorda, Gonsua, and Sao Jorge Island, playing a vital role in preserving critical ecosystems. After thorough public review and consideration by the TCP Board, the proposals have received final approval. However, the implementation hinges on the high court's resolution of ongoing writ petitions, reinforcing protection for these ecologically significant zones.

news.title: Hyderabad development body to auction prime land parcels in Kokapet
news.para: Prime lands in Hyderabad's Kokapet area are set for auction by the Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority. The upset prices start at ₹120 crore per acre for the Neopolis layout and ₹70 crore for Golden Mile. In addition, several residential plots throughout Hyderabad will also be sold. The auction is scheduled from August 24 to September 9, with the authority expecting to raise substantial revenue from these transactions.

news.title: More than 90% projects in Kolkata didn’t have any structural issue: Audit
news.para: In a recent safety audit, most highrise projects were confirmed to be structurally sound, with around half having resumed construction and more on the way. This initiative followed a severe warehouse collapse, prompting the government to review 706 projects. Notably, only 26 of these showed significant violations, none associated with Credai members. Consequently, Credai is actively advising buyers to select units in RERA-approved developments.

news.title: Mumbai: ₹1,351 crore bid for Century Mills plot to come up before BMC panel on August 12
news.para: The BMC's improvement committee will greenlight a 30-year lease for the Century Mills site located in Lower Parel. Peddar Realty Ltd's bid, amounting to Rs 1,351 crore, topped the offers for the redevelopment initiative. Presently, the site is home to 476 eligible mill workers' families and ten shops. Families will receive new 405 square feet flats for permanent housing.
